opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over, be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with a UK/ROI address and bank account), or be applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI. Projects must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement and public outreach activities that connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC member (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; holds an independent research post; must not hold another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months for chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs/access.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC member of Partner Scientist, Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) categories; either a PhD student in the chemical sciences or a researcher in the chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists in industry and academia to undertake activities that develop their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses or organising scientific meetings. Up to £500 per grant.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be an Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) of the RSC before submitting and for the duration of the grant. Open to PhD students or researchers at any career stage, working in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including research visits to collaborators and organising meetings/workshops. Up to £5000.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicant must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting/conference/workshop/professional development event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering additional costs incurred for care they usually provide. Up to £1,200 per year. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicant must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will use funds to cover costs of support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 per year to help with the cost of specific support to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event, reducing accessibility challenges for individuals with disabilities and ongoing health conditions. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.
